verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's only documented in-product AI feature is Query Assistant, which turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. That is a narrow, single-purpose helper rather than an assistant you can hand broader investigation tasks to. The richer agentic capabilities (MCP server, agent skills plugin) rely on external AI agents connecting to Honeycomb, not a built-in assistant, and 'Canvas investigation tools' appear only as an MCP tool listing with no in-product description. Missing for 10: a documented built-in assistant that executes multi-step tasks (investigations, board or trigger creation) inside the UI, detail on Canvas as an in-product agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
